_label: SYNTHETIC TEST CASES (handoff §10.2). These are not real carbon projects. Boundaries are 0.05-degree boxes chosen for their real satellite evidence (cached in data/cache/evidence/ev2-*.json); every claim carries dataLabel=synthetic.
_developers: DEV = key 0x11..11 (32 bytes), DEV2 = key 0x22..22. Public test keys: never fund them on a real network.

cases.title: Clean project passes with a high score
cases.why: Intact forest in central Amazonas: 99% tree cover in 2000, 0 ha loss 2019-2025, stable NDVI (+0.005/yr). 30,000 credits on ~3,070 ha = 9.8 t/ha.

claim.boundarySource: Synthetic 0.05-degree box, Amazonas, Brazil. Not a real project boundary.

cases.title: Duplicate claim: same land, same vintage, different developer is blocked
cases.why: Identical boundary to case 1, vintage 2023, signed by DEV2.

cases.title: Partial overlap is blocked and reports the overlapping fraction
cases.why: Case 1's box shifted 0.02 degrees east: 60% of the new boundary lies on SYN-01-CLEAN's land for the same vintage.

claim.boundarySource: Synthetic: SYN-01-CLEAN's box shifted 0.02 degrees east.

cases.title: Same land, different vintage is allowed
cases.why: Rule: uniqueness is per (land, vintage). A later vintage on the same land is the next crediting period, not a double count (see DECISIONS.md).

cases.title: Claim contradicted by satellite gets a low score and cannot issue
cases.why: Avoided-deforestation claim on a Nova Mamoré (Rondônia) deforestation frontier: Hansen GFC shows 8% of the remaining forest lost inside the box in the claimed vintage (2022). It registers, with a low score and a LOW_INTEGRITY_SCORE warning; the contract refuses issuance (score < 60).

claim.boundarySource: Synthetic 0.05-degree box, Rondônia, Brazil. Not a real project boundary.

cases.title: Retrying the same submission creates no duplicate record
cases.action: Re-send case 1 with the same Idempotency-Key.

cases.title: Over-retirement reverts
cases.action: Developer issues 100 credits, retires 100, then tries to retire 1 more.

cases.title: Tampering with the stored claim is detected
cases.action: Edit claimedCredits in the backend database after registration, then call /claims/SYN-01-CLEAN/verify.
